Something continued to nag at the back of my mind during the frequent stops and combat encounters. There was this one thing I just could not understand.
一路走走停停着与来挡路的敌人战斗，有一件事我无论如何也想不通。

dataList.content:
This is pretty much expected from Vergilius at this point, but...
虽然维吉里乌斯这样做也不是一两次了……

<... If he already knew where we were going, and why... would it hurt to tell us for once?>
<如果早就知道的话为什么不告知我们呢……>

I muttered to myself while looking toward the back of the bus where Aeng-du slept. She was still out cold.
我看着在后座静静呼吸着的樱桃，小声说道。

<Come on, Faust. I legitimately think that this is something we have to talk about. Can you please relay my question to Vergilius...?>
<浮士德，这算是正当的提议吧。可以帮我转述一下……>

Hah, if you won't do it, then I will. A journey can't always be sunshine and rainbows—some friction is necessary. You there, guide!
哈，那就由我来吧。冲突有时是必要的。喂，向导！

Outis relayed my question, then began to share some of her own grievances with Vergilius.
……奥提斯口若悬河地转述着我的提问和自己的不满。

... A LOT of her own grievances.
虽然二者的比重明显偏斜了……

... Haah, are you finished?
……唉，说完了吗。

Well, you're not wrong. I did hear most of the details through the radio.
确实如此。他们已经通过无线电向我传达了详细的内容。

And here's why I didn't tell you in advance.
不过我没有提前告知你们的理由。

It's because you're the kind of people who never learn until the 'problem' comes crashing through your front door. Would you have done anything differently if you knew in advance? It'll only serve to give you an excuse to whine about it.
你们都是必须要到大事临头才能学会的人才，所以才特意没有提前告知你们而已。反正就算说了也只会引起更多的逆反心理吧。

So there it is. What now, manager? Will you refuse this mission?
所以，经理。你是想拒绝这次的工作吗？

<... How could I? They're already treating us like dirt. If I refuse this, I can't imagine how much worse it'll get.>
<……怎么会。我们的待遇本来就是底层，做出那种选择，想必会突破底层到地下室吧。>

I'm sure you're thinking 'How could I?'. And you'd be right.
你肯定觉得不能这么做吧。

I can tell from the way he's looking at me that he already knew what I was going to say.
他的眼神和话语像是确信我会这么做。

I'm starting to wonder if he really can't hear me.
对他能否听到我说的话这一事，我甚至有点混乱起来。

Ah, our guest is awake.
看来客人也正好醒了。

You should go and ask her for directions, manager. Charon's intuition can only take us so far.
靠卡戎的直觉没法找到准确的位置，看来还是亲自询问比较好，经理。

Again, this would have gone much smoother if we had been told where we were going from the start. But like always, Vergilius felt the need to add comments like that before shutting me down and turning away. He'd already closed his eyes.
如果事先在外面便得到情报就更好了。维吉里乌斯故意补充一句，然后再度闭上眼睛转过头去。

Hm, ahm. Allow me to explicate our present circumstances to her.
……咳咳。我去说明吧。

Yi Sang got up with an awkward smile in an attempt to clear the air.
像是要缓和这尴尬的气氛，李箱摆出一副僵硬的笑容站起了身。

After some time...
过了一段时间……

Yi Sang seemed to have successfully explained our circumstance to Aeng-du; she was standing next to Charon, trying to give her proper directions.
樱桃在李箱的说明下理解了现状，她正在驾驶席给卡戎传达详细位置。

She had also told us that, as long as we assisted her with her mission, she wouldn't mind us taking the black stele for ourselves.
同时说道，只要给她帮忙，那个对他们无处可用的黑色石碑当然会给我们。

People dressed in Kurokumo Clan's garbs were wandering around the building, standing guard before its entrance.
正如她所说，大楼前正有几个看似是黑云会成员的人在附近走动，警戒着四周。

I have to...! Agh, mentor Bamboo-hatted Kim...!
我要下车……！呃，金笠大人……！

Delaying further will only allow the Distortion to grow more powerful. We must enter the building as soon as possible.
扭曲的时间越长，镇压的难度也会越大。我们赶快进入大楼吧。

Aeng-du had already leaped out of the bus and was rushing in with her weapon drawn. We quickly followed suit.
跟着已经急匆匆跑出巴士的樱桃，我们都跑向了大楼。
